1.2 The principles to be followed in the enlistment of Contractors shall be as 
follows : 

(1 ) Applications from all intending contractors shall be invited by means of adver 
tisement with wide publicity so as to reach Government before a specified 
date . 
(2 ) Those who have already applied for enlistment or are enlisted as contractor 
before the formulation of these rules, shall, on the issue of advertisement 
submit copies of their previous applications with full particulars required under 
these rules or shall submit fresh applications with all the requisite partioulars . 
(3) Each applicant in his application shall furnish the following particular 
and shall attach & certificate from a responsible person of status that the 
partioulars are true to his knowledge and belief : 
(a ) The name and full address of the person or firm and if a firm each 

partner being specifically designated with name and address . 
(b ) The extent of his own sbare in the firm and the name and shares 

of other partners. 
( o) The amount of his capital and the manner in which it is hold Necessary 

certificate also in suport of his independent financial positiop from 4 reve 
pue offhoot not below the rank of Sub - Deputy Collector, just also be 
furnished by contincters applying for onlistment in clau I , I and III.

(6 ) After all such applications have beon received , the Government will consider

1.3 For works put to tenders and costing above Rs. 1 lakh , competitive open 
tender shall be called for from experiencoil und resourceful contractors and enlisted 
contractors of class I and II only . If contractors in Class III or IV from a combi 
nation of the appropriate number, such a combination will become a now firm and 
if registered as a firm will be able to submit tender for such works. Individual 
contractor in Class II ! and IV shall not be eligible for tender for such work but if 

can produce satisfactory documentary evidence such as bank reference to show 
that he has sufficient financial means and necessary technical staff permission may 
he given to such persons for submission of tenders for such works by a spöcial 
order of the Government.. 

Notwithstanding anything contained in these rules , the Government 
to itself the right of making additions, alterations and deletion to these rules or 
ti the lists as tbe case may be , 

Provided further that in any dispute arising from the interpretation of these 
rules the decision of the Chief Commissioner, Manipur vill be final.

EXTRACTS FROM THE REGULATIONS RELATING TO THE GOVT. OF INDIA 
SCHOLARSHIPS FOR SCHEDULED CASTES & SCHEDULED TRIBES 

AND OTHER BACKWARD CLASSES - 1955--56 . 
Regulation No. 13 

A Government of India scholarship holder will not hold any other scholarship 
except a merit scholarship from University or Board or from the State Govt. or 
s grant for purchase of text books from any source ; but if awarded state Govt . 
or any other scholarship of higher value not based on merit, he / she will have the 
option to avail of that scholarship after ri-funding the entire amount of the Central 
Scholarsbip drawn during the year. In cases where the value of Central Scholarship 
is less than that of State Scholarship , the State Goveroment may , if they go desire , 
supplement the Central Scholarship of a particular scholar by reising it to the lovel 
of the State Scholarship ,

PRESS NOTE . 


Imphal, the 5th January , 1956 . 

Federation of British Industries Scholarships 1956 . 
The Federation of the British Industries in the United Kingdom have offered 6 
Overseas scholarships for practical Training of Indian Engineers in the British Indus- . 
tries, in defferent branches of Engineering . Of these 6 scholarships 3 will be fully 
paid ( A type) and 3 divided botweou types B & C . 

Typos A & B Scholarships are tenable for two years and ti to 12 months for 
type C scholarships. Maintenance allowance to the value of £ 390 per annum (£ 420 
if the works to wbich the scholar is attached is within the London postal area ) 
for Types A and B and $ 500 for Type C will bo given. In case of Types B 
and the scholars have to make a contribution of £ 100 por annum towards 
maintenance . Passage expense for all types of scholarships will be borne by the 
Federation and the Govt . of Indig . 

Applicants must hold a degree or an equivalent diploma in engineering . The 
last date of receipt of applicatious in the Ministry of Education , Scholarships Divi 
sion , Government of India , New Delhi is 31. 1. 19:36 . 

Necessary particulars regarding the scholarsbips and copies of the application forms 
can be had from the Government of India , Ministry of Education, Scholarship 
Divisions. Section 8-1 New Delhi and may also be seen from the 

office of the 
A mistant/Secretary Educatiou to the Government of Manipur. 

Gopendra Sharma , 
Publicity Officer , Manipur .

ভ০-১২৫৫ইং 
অসিনা মরম ওইদুনা প্রজা পুমমা খহনজরি । মরদি - শীখাে ধূমখােং অসি তাং ১৫১৫৬ ইংগী তাং ৩১ 
৩৫৭ ই ফাওৰা ধুম শুং বনবগীদমক ফোরেষ্ট অফিস্যা তাং ২০১৫৬ ইংগী নুংথিল পুং অম বা মতমদা নিলাম

PRESS NOTE .. 
RECOGNITION OF CAMBRIDGE HICHER SCHoor. CERTIFKATE . 
In a Press Note datod January 19, 1955 , the Union Public Servio Comunission announced 
their decision to withdraw recognition of the Cambridge Higher Schoul Certificate as an 
alternative qualification for candidates for the Indian Police Sorvice , recruitment to which 
is made from the Indian Administrative Service etc. examination . It was announced that 
the withdrawal would be effective from the examination to be held in 1956 . 

T he Union Public Service Commission have considered this matter again and have now 
decided to postpone the implementation of this decision for the time being. Accordingly 
the Cambridge Higher School Certificate examinatiou will be recognised as an alternative 
qnalification for recruitment to the Indian Police Service by examination in 1956 and 
thereafter until a fresh announcement is mude .

Imphal, the 18th January , 1956 . 

JANUARY 26 TO BE A PAID HOLIDAY . 
In pursuance of instructions issued by the Union Ministry of Labour on previous 
anniversaries of the Republic Day, workers were permitted to participate in the 
celebratinns on January 26 without being made to suffer any loss in wages . 

A similar directive has been issued this year by the Government of India to 
their officers in bharge of industrial undertakings and they hope that other employers 
as well will co -operate with thein hy declaring this national day as a paid holiday . 

In view of the great importance of the occasion , Governinent believe that many 
industrial undertakings have already prescribe 1 January 26 as one of their regular 
holidays ; . but where this has not been done, they hope employers will treat the 
day as an additional paid holiday and nit as a substituted holiday. 

Gopendra Salma, 
Publicity Officer , Manipur.

বারমদিঃ -১ নং । গ্রীসাম অমুবাসিংহ স সগোলবন্দ সলাম লৈকাই । 

২ নং । ঐসলাম ইবােমচাসিংহ সাং কৈশমিপ থােকচোম :ৈকাই । 
এসলাম অাহলসিংহ সাং সপােলবন্দ সলাম লৈকাই উক্ত বাদ্বিয়না ইস্ফাল পানা না . W. 1. সাঃ গোলবল 
শলাম লৈকাইদা লৈ উক্ত বিবাদিন দখন তোরি লম অসি সলাম শাশৈগ মাে ফমনি ময়ুম মকৈ শিদোকহনবিয়ু হায়না 
কেশ থাংপা উক্ত বাদি অনিবু সল । শাগৈগী মংশিনবা ওইনা লোরদুনা কেশ তোবদা করি গুম্বা রানিং বা লেয়বদি 
তাং ৬২৭৬ ইং ফাওবগী মনুদা নসা নসাল কেশত য়াওনিংৰা লৈরব যা ওজগে হায়না না হয়নি বা পুম্নমক ইছুনা

নােটিশ নং ১ [ােন] 

তাং ২১১। ৫৬ ইং 
১। মনিপুবগী লৌ - উশিউবগী থবক অমসুং ও যোকপনচিংবগী মবমা চাওখৎনবগম ভাবত সাবনা সুপ 
লাখ ৩ ( জহুম) মনিপুবগী প্রজাণিংদা শেল পুথােৰুৰা পৰে । 

২। শেলশিং অলি কো - ওপবােটত সােসাইটি অমসুং কালুপ নাইনা পুনশিল্পবা কাশিতদা পুবা গনি , মা 
না মীলা শেল পুব বােই । 

৩। থৌৰাল তহশিল, ইম্ফাল ইঃ তহশিল , মাও তহশিল অমসুং উখল সব-ডিভিজন অসি প্রােজেক্ত এরিয়া অন্য 
নেশনের একষ্টেশন সার্ভিস লােক্কী মং চরি । মখী সমশিং অসিদা লৈ কো - ওপবোট সােসাইটিশিং অমসুং কাল 
নাই শেল পুগে হায়বা কাংবুশিংগীদি মনিপুবগী ডিপুটি কমিশনাব, প্লাজিং অমসুং ডিভেলোপমেন্ট সেক্স দৰখা 
খাগবনি । মাখােইগীদমক লুপা লাখ ১৫ ( অমা মখাই ) গনি । 

৪। ইম্ফাল ওয়েষ্ট তহশিল, বিষ্ণুপুৰ তহশিল, কামেংলোং সব -ডিভিজন, চুবাচান্দপুব, জিরিবাৰ সৰ- ডিভিখন অমসুং 
ভেংনৌপল তহশিলগী মনু,চনবা কো - ওপবােট সােসাইটি অমসুং কালুপ নাইবা শেল পুগে হায়বা কাংখুন ডিপুটি কমিশনার 
ফিশবি সেক্স পুগদবা শেলগীদমক সবখাস্ত থাগদবনি । মাখােইগীদমক লুপা লাখ ১২ ( অমা মখাই) শীগনি । 

দরখাস্ত থাগদৰা কাংখুন মাখােই মাখােইগী দবখাস্ত অদু পুগে হায়বা শেলশিং, মাদুগ মগদবা জামিনগ অগ 
মৰােল অমসুং কব পৰক পাংখোকগীদমক শেল অঞ্চ পুগে হায়বিক মরােল পামক শুইনা ইদুনা ইং ১৯৫৬ 
মার্চ ১ লা ভাগ মংলা ডিপুটি কমিশনাব প্লানিং অমসুং ডিভেলােভমেন্ট সেক্সন নগা ফিশৰি সেন্দা দবখাস্তশি ছু 
মনিপুবগী এসিষ্টেন্ট বেজিষ্টাৰ ওফ কো - ওপবেটিভ সােসইটিজ ফাওনা খাবনা খুংহল্পগদৰনি । গনগদ আনিন্দি লো 
ইখোল নগা পুথোক পুশিন য়াদ লেংদনা লৈ মান চাং ওইগদবনি । 

লৌ ইথোলচিংবগী জামিন ওইদি মাগী হৌজিক হৌজিকী ওইবা মল লেপলগা যমল অদুগী ১০০ দা ৭০ অনুগ 
এতে অতৈ মান চাং ওইরগা মাচাং অদুগী মমল লেগ মিল অদুগী ১০০ দা ৫০ তমক গনি । 

( ক ) গুহা টিউব ওয়েল অমসুং পুশিং ভৌনবা । 
( খ) গুহাশিং অমসু পুশিং মোবামত তৌনন । 
(গ ) ঈশিং চিংখণবা ইঞ্জিন অমসুং অতৈ ঋজু খুৎলাই পাংখৎন । 
( খ) ঈথৈ চা শেষগৎবা । 
(ঙ) লম শেমগৎবা হায়বদি লৌনৌ নিনবা , লৌবি নাবা, চহিদা চাখােক অমুক্কা খােবা লৌবা চদি

( ছ) মহৈ মৰবাং পৈননবাকৈ অমসুং লৌ তাংশং শাননবা ।

Examination for admission to Sainik School. 
No. D /HP/58 /52. - An examination for admission to the Sainik School ( formerly 
Prince of Wales Military College ), Dehra Dun , will be held on March , 23 , 1968 , 
at Iraphal. It will consist of both written and viva voce tests . Candidates who 
qualify in the tests will be required to undergo a medical examination at the Mili 
tary Hospital nearest the homes . Only those who are medically fit will be eligible 
for admission to the Sainik Sobool. 

Applications in duplicate on prescribed forms should reach the State Governmonts 
in whose jurisdictions the applicant s parents or guardians ordinarily reside by not 
later than Maroh 1, 1956 . Candidates seeking admission to the School should not 
be less than 11 years of age but must not have attained the age of 12 years on 
let August, 1966. Age liinits will not be relaxed . 

Full particulars regarding the course of training , specimen question papers, eta . 
and application forms can be obtained from the Secretary to the State Govero 
ment Hume Department or the Principal, Sainik School , Debra Dun . 

By ordor etc. 

T. Kipgen ,

Imphal, the 8th February , 1906 . 

Issue of Passports in Calcutta Region . 
The Regional Passport Office, Calcutta Rigion located at No. 4, Brubourne Road , 
Calcutta will take over the reponsibility for issuing Indian International Passports 
from the Government of Manipur with effect from Wednesday , the 15th February . 
19:36 . Indo-Pak Passports will continue to be issued by the Governmeat of Manipur. 

An applicant for a Passport from Manipur should complete the prescribed form 
in duplicate and submit togeiher with three copies of photograph to his/ her District 
Magistrate from whom also application forms can be had . The application should 
be accompanied by either (i) # Certificate from the appropriate Revenue Authority 
(not below the rauk of a Tehsildar ) giving the value of any immovable property 
in the possession of the applicant or (ii) a certificate from a bank giving the period 
during which the applicant bas been their client and anount at his credit at the 
time of application or (ii) if the applicant has a fixed income only , & certificate 
from the Head of Department, Firin etc. giving his monthly income. If an appli 
cant can produce none of these certificatos be should submit a financial guarantea 
from a suitable person in the prescribed form . 

The Passport fee which is Rs. 10 :- for an Indian “ International" Pitssport and 
Rs. 8 /- for an Indo -Ceylon Passport should either be remitted by money Order direct 
to the Regional Prosport Officer indicating in the Money Order coupon the authority 
to whom the application has b.en made or be banded in at the counter of the 
Regional Passport Office und & receipt obtained . The postal receipt for the Money 
Order should be attached to the application . The lasspist when roudy will be sent 
direct to the applicant by Registered Post by the Regional Passport Office. 

Decisious on passport applioations submitted upto 14th February , 1951i, will be 
taken by the Government of Manipur. All enquirie legariling such applications should , 
therefore, he woude from the Government of Manipur unless otherwise notified by thein . 

S. U. Ghosh 
Regionil Passport Officer, Caloutta

No. STO /li/3- প্রজা পুমা খংহঞ্জরী, মাহুদি ষ্টেট ট্রেজি অফিসনা ইংশােক ১৯৫৬ ফেব্রুয়ারী খাগ 
গী তারিখ অমসুং জাপ মতু ইন্না চেঙ লৌজগনি । চেংগী মমলদি বােড় । য়াওনা নণদা সুপা ( মাপল ) নি । 

গড়া , গাড়ীদগী থাংথবা , ওনৰা অমসুং গুদামদা থসজিনবর্গ ( ষ্টোক তো খর্চ চেঙ অল্পী মীনা 
নীৰনি । হােড়াদি অহনা ওইগৰনি অমসুং বােড়। অমদা চেঙ মণ ২ ( অনি মখায় ) পদবনি । 

বা মী খুদিয়কনা “ লৌউবা মীনি অমসুং ভরীবা চেঞ্জ অদু মশা -মশানা উবা লৌগী থােকপা চেঙনি " 
হয়না অই চে অমা ( ডিক্লারেশন ) খুলগ জবা বা স্বাক্ষী আমদ্ৰবদা অমা মাওনা সহী তোহনা পবিগদবনি । 

ষ্টেট ট্রেডিং অফিসনা লৌগদবা চেঙগ নমুনা ( সেম্পল ) অফিস -থমজরে । চেও তদ্বিগে হায়বা দেউবা মখৈনা অফিস 
জন সেম্পল য়েংবিরগদবনি । কলাগুৰ মীনা সেম্পলদগী তানা চেঙ বিরদি চেঙ লৌরােই ( বিজে 
গেনি ) । 

চেঙ লৌবা মরেদি কৈথেল কৈথেলগী ওইনা মখাদা পীরিবা তারিখ অনং মশিণী মতুঃ ইন্না বাজার 
বাজাৱনা কোল্লিবা খুলশিংলা লৈবা লৌউশিংগী অমুক পুঙ ৯ ( মাপন ) দগী চেঙ লৌবা হৌজগনি । নোংমলা 
পৰি পরিবা বাজারশিংগী মণশীং অদুদগী হেয় পুবিরকপা অগী দায়ী আফিসনা পুৰোই । অহেনা চেও মৈ 
লেবােই । চেঙ ধীগদবা মীশিংনা ষ্টেট ট্রেডিং আফিসকী কোহােংগী ৰংমা অকোন অহান নাইনা লেংদুনা 
বিগবন । 
চেঙ অস্বাগদবা মী পুদিনা মাগী মাগী তারিখ থােকপা সুমিত্তা অরুক ও ৯ গী মমাগুদ 

গী মমাঙা টেট টেছি 
আফিতা চেঙ গৌহনরিকলবনি । অমুক পুঃ ৯ ( মাপন ) গী মতুদ। পবিৱকপাচেও লৌৱােই । পুৰিকলি ।

International Law scholarships. 

· New Delhi, February 10 , 1966 . 
The Haguo Academy of International Law has offered number of scholarships of 
the value of 300 guilders (about Rs. 37 (1). Out of these upto two are to be awarded 
to Indian nationals during 1956 Session . (from July 16 to August 11, 1956 ). 

Applications stating the applicant s surname, first mame, qualifimtione profussion , 
sationality, plans and date of birth , together with a statement of titles which the 
applicant considers of value for obtaning a scholarship sbould be submitted by the 
applicant to the Secretariat of the Academy Peaca Palace , The Hague , direct BO 
to reach them by April 1, 1986 . 

Further information regarding regulations , eto . governing these boholarships may 
be obtained direct from the Academy.

Imphal, the 26th February , 1966. 
Whereas a case of defalcation of money from the Manipur Co -operative Bank Ltd., 
Imphal by the former Secretary Shri K. Nabakishore Singh has been reported and 
whereas the said Secretary is absoonding yet, I have appointed Shri Iswar Chandra 
Dutta , Retd . Govt. Officer Maxwell Bazar, Imphal, to audit the accounts of the 
said Bank and report the position for further steps in the matter. 

It is hereby notified for the information of all members and other constituents 
interested in the said Bank that all claims and objections should be preferred to the 
above named Auditor, duly supported by documentary evidenco on or before the 
7th March , 1956. Any claims preferred after that date and without supporting ovi 
dence will not be considered . 

P. C. S. Bordoloi,

PRESS NOTE . 

Imphal, the 28th February , 1966 . 
No. V. 7. Pross /Pab /65 /III . - The Government of India have constituted À now 
jowioo known as the Indian Frontier Administrative Service to fill certain posts in 
the North East Frontier Agenoy , Manipur and Tripura . Selection for this nervios 
will be made from 

(i) Officers of the Indian Administrative Service, the Indian Foreign Service 

or the Indian Police Service ; 
(ii) Officers who bold or have held permanent short service , temporary or 

emergency commission in the Defence Forces ; and 
(iii) Other persons whose applications_Are forwarded by the Central Govt., 
the State Govts . , the North East Frontier 

the North East Frontier Agency Admioistration 
and the Universities . 
2. There are 11. vacancies of Political Officers in grade 1 and 7 vacancies of 
Assistant Political Officers grade II and the time scale of pay admissible to member 
of the service will be as follows : 

Grade Il- Rs. 350-400-450-450-500-540-30-600-EB- 30-870-40-950 /- (19 years). 
Grade I Rs. 800-(6th year or under )-50-1000-60-1300-50-1800 /- ( 25 years). 

The probationery period for those who are directly recruited to the services will 
be one year but the Central Government may, if they think fit , reduce or extend 
the period of probation in individual cases. According to the existing orders spo 
cial pay of 331 % of basic pay with a minimum of Rs. 200 /- and maximum of Rs. 400/ 
por month will be allowed to those with head quarters in forward arı 88. Class I 
Officers at shillong will be allowed A special pay of Rs. 150 /- per month only . All 
Officers in forward areas will be entitled to frem furnished accommodation of a simple 
type on a scale to be decided by the Governor in consultation with Financial Advisor . 
Officers with headquarters at Shillong will be given house rout allowance as allowed 
to other Central Government servants stationed at Shillong . 

2. Conditions in these areas are totally different from those in the rest of India , 
including other tribal areas, and require a special typo of officer. He must be very 
fit physically and possess special qualitics of initiative, imagination , resourcefulness , 
and a broad sympathy for, and an understanding of tribal peuple with an interest 
in their life and customs Officers will be required to serve in the forward 
in very diffioult conditions, the communications are very poor and social amenities 
hardly exist . They will be expected to live among the tribes , learn their languages , 
manders and customs, and win their confidence and trust. They will also have to 
00 -ordinate the activities of the various development departments suob as Agricultura, 
Engineering , Health , Education eto . Married Officers , specially those whose wives are 
interested in welfare work , will be preferred . 

4. To the extent suitable candidates are available , upto 20 % of the total autho 
rised strength of the cadre (excluding doputation and leave reserves ) shall be filled 
by promotion of officers belonging to the local services of the North East Frontier 
Agency and the States of Manipur & Tripura on the advice of the Special Seleo 
tion Board . 

$. The last dato for submission of application to the Secretary , Ministry of Ex 
tornal Affairs , Govt. of India is 31st March , 1956. Further details of the new service 
will be available from the Secretariat, Home Branch ; Office of the Deputy Commi 
sioner , Manipur and Sub - Divisional Offices in the Tribal srias. 

Gopondra Sharma, 
Publicity Officer , Manipur.

fishery Mahala

( 1) The officer conducting the sale does not biud himself to accept the highest 
bid or any bid and reserves discretion to auotiou the settlemont for either a longer 
or shorter term than that specified abive. Sucouesful bidder will be required to 
produce a solvency cortificite before his bid is confirmed . 

( 2 ) The purchaser shall immediately after acceptance of his bid , where the bid 
exceeds Rs. 100 /- furnish as security & sum equal to onu quarter of 4 year s revenuo , 
or Rs. 100 /- wbiobever is the greater, and shall require to furnish withiu q days 
of the date of sale additional security to the satisfaction of ibe D. ( . HO HB to 
bring up the total amount of the securiiy to one third of the revenue fur the full 
term of the settlement. If the bid is Rs. 100 /- or loss , tbe enjire bid amount must 
be paid immediately after the acceptance of the bid . 

If he fails to furnish the initial or the additi mal security as prescribed above 
the fishery shall be resold at his risk in the formor Case, forthwith ; in the later 
puso , after issue of the notice preseribed by rule 185 , and in other case he shall

for that period by the subsequent sale .

Imphal, tho 19th March , 1956 . 
The Committee represonting the Royal Society and the University of Cambridge 
in vites applicatwns for the Smithson Kosearch Feiloish p . 

This Followship is open to British snbjects , including subj ots of the Empire , 
widtout d.stinction of sex . 

In accurdiance with the beqiings of the late M " . E. W. Smiths in , the object of 
the Fellowship is to promote research in natural science , with a view to the dis 
oovery of new laws and principles , rather than the exploit ition of what is known . 

Preferenre will be givon to candid itus pot more thru thirty - five years of age . 
The appointment will be made for four years from 1 Ortober , 1956 , but may

বেড় অনলা কে মণ । (জনি) আপনি। ফৌ তন্মরী মী খুদিংশা “লৌউবা মীনি অমসুং এরী কে জ 

মশানা বা সৌগ থােক ফেীনি ” হায় এই চে অমা (ডিক্যারেসন) খুগ বা ৰা স্বাক্ষী মাত্র 
যা মাওনা সহি যেীনা পীগৰনি । 
ষ্টেট ট্রেডিং আফিসনা ফৌগ নমুনা (সেল) অফিস থমজরে । ফৌ তম্বিগে হায়বা লৌউবা মখৈনা আফিতা 

সেশল মেৰিগদবনি । কনাগু মীনা সেম্পলদগী না ফৌ পুবিরক্লদি ফৌ লৌজনােই (বিজেক্ট ভৌগনি ) । 
কে সে মরেলি কৈথেল কৈথেলগ ওইনা মালা পিরি তারিখ অং ৭ ণৰিাগ তুইলা ৰা ৰাৰা 
কোলি খুশিল লৈ লোটশিংগ অমুক পু (মাপলদগী) ফৌ গোল হৌগলি । নােম পিরি পিরি 

শিগ গণশিংহদ হে পুরিপা অগ দায়ী আফিনা পুৰোই । অহেন ফো মখে লেগেই । 
কৌ ৰীগৰা মীশিনা ষ্টেট ট্রেজিং আফিমকী কোদােংগ রামদা গাড়ী কোন অহন নাইনা লেংদুন লৈৰিগৰনি । 

কৌ অধীগদ মী বুদিংমা মাগী মাগী তারিখ থােকপা দুমি অমুক পুং ৯ গ মমাংলা ষ্টেট ট্রেজি আলি ।

Jo connection with bids offered at auctions by displaced persons with verified 
claims there appoars to be some confusion as to the manner in which adjustments 
of the compensation diet to there liimanty ani their associates against the purchase 
pricu , ale to be made . In order to avoid misunderslanding, the position is being 
olarified in this I ross Note. The rules fr.med under the Displaced Persous ( Com 
pensation and Rehabilitation ) Act permit an auction purchaser to assuciate genuine 
purchasers with him in purchasing proper y trom the componsatiou 1ool. The rules 
provide that such o lition is p - rmissıhlo IV when the net compensation due to 
an auction purohuser is not sufficient to cova ine purchase price . Some auction pur 
chusets love the mistaken im rezsion that they can asociate with themselves any 
punilier of other persons , and that it is not negendary for the whole of the not com . 
periaalin due to those persons to be set off. The currect p sition is that the same 
rule whioh 4pplies to the auction purchaser applies to his lasociates , i. e, that a second 
takvoi qte oan only be brou : ht in by the auction purchaser it after adjustment of 
the whole componmtion due to the fi st Associate a balance still remains, and so on 
it is only where the halai oo due is less than the net compensation of an associate 
that a pription of his compensation is adjusted , sufficient to cover his balance.

নােটিশ । 

ইদাল অং ২২৩৫৬ ইং 
শং এস ৮ ও ১১৫৫৩৮৪৯৫ - এ পুমা হথরী মাছুদি ষ্টেট ট্রেতি আফিল ইংশােক ১৯৫৬ এপ্রিল এ 
এ তারিখ অমসুং বাজারগ মতুংইয়া কৌ লৌজগনি । লৌগদ ফৌমী মমিংদি ফৌ, চলৈ, ফৌরেন, কৌছ , 
নেইয়াংফৌ অমসুং ককচেংফৌ অলিনি । ফৌদি ফৌয়াম চেল লৈখােম লৈ দৈৰা সুনশা শেং ওইগদৰনি । কে 
শাদি মণদা বােড় যাওনা সুপা ৫ ( পা মঙ ) নি । হোৱা ভাড়া , গাড়ীগ থাংবা, ওন অমসুং গুদামা থমজিনস (টোক 
ভোবশ ) চ ফৌ তন্মী মীনা নগদৰনি । বােড়াদি অহনবা ওইগদৰনি বােড় অমদা কে মণ ২ (জনি) হাপকনি। 
ফৌ তরী মী খুদিংমা “ লৌউবা মীনি অমসুং তস্মরীবা ফৌ অনু মশা -মশানা উবা লৌদগী থােকপা ফৌনি ” 
হায় এই চে অমা (ডিক্লারেসন ) খুগীথাবা য়াবা স্বাক্ষী আমদ্ৰবা অমা মাওনা সহি তেনা পগলবনি । 

ষ্টেট ট্রেডিং অফিসনা ফৌগ নমুনা সেম্পল) আফিস থমজরে । ফৌ তেিগ হায় লৌউবা মখৈনা আফি 
লাভুনা সেম্পল য়েংবিরগদবনি । কলাগুৰা মীনা সেম্পলদগী না ফৌ পুবিৰদি ফৌ লৌজন্যেই (রিজেন্ট ভৌগনি ) । 

ফৌ লৌবা মরৌদি কৈথেল কৈথেগী ওইনা মখালা পিজবি তারিখ অমসুং মণশিগ মতুংই বাজার বাজার 
কোৱিষা খুলশিংদা লৈৰা লৌউবশিংগী অমুক পুং ৯ (মাপলদগী) ফৌ লৌল হৌজগনি । নােমদা পিরি পিরি 
বারশিংগী মণশিং অদুদগী হেদা পুবিবকপা অদুগ দাষী আফিনা পুরােই । আহেন ফৌ মখৈ সৌজনেই । 
ফৌ তদীগদবা মীশি না ষ্টেট ট্রেন্ডিং অফিসকী কোম্বোংগী বা মদা গাড়ী অকোন অহান নাইনা লেংদুনা লৈবিগদবনি । 

ফৌ তখীগদবা মী খুদি মা মাগী মাগী তাৰিখ থােকপা নুমিত্তা অরুক পুং ৯ গ মমাংদা ষ্টেট ট্রেডি আফিম 
ফৌ মৌহনবিবদৰনি । অযুক পু ৯ (মাপল) গী মতু দা পুবিবকপা ফৌ লৌজনােই । পুবিবরি ফৌ পুৱমক কে 
সৌদ্রি ফাওবা গাড়ীদা থম্বীগদবনি । লৈপাতা থাদদুনা খা যাবেই । 
মতুংগী লৌবমাইদা অতােপ্পা নােটিশ অম অমুক তৌজরনি ।

লা খুং থিংস পায়। 
এ পা ছুঝি। লোশী ( গাইণ ) না মীয় বৈদো লৈকাই ৰীমা মেশিগৰিকা আয় 
এ চিৰিয়াইনি। মা লিলি বৌমা মেহেদি মায়া লা লা ওই । ময়ৰ অহনা হক গংগা 

লা লােগ জেলা মেডিকেল ওফিসার ( লোসী ) লাকনা লাইনে ভৌবিৰা কৈ । মহেশালা অনান্য 
ঙ্গি তুই না না শ ও মতমদা লাইমেংবা চোখােলকই । মালিয়ায় চুল পোৰি । নানি 

এ এস মু মন দি লৈকোক লৈফাইল আমাৰা অলি শোনাে থকা করে । কোনাে পরি .

: এলিশ এ মা শাৰ এসি শশােঙ্কল হিনা জলি না পুফি বিন হয়নি । আর সরকারী 

শো লেপ্রােলিকহোলী মই অনাৰী মী অমসুংগলা শয়- cংশ ( contact) মাশিস ময়ুৰ মংলা 
रिवार नामका बार कोशि । पागि बाबा হগনি । আমি তোদি আমগা আগা গোলগৰি ৰায়ণ বিক

SCHOLARSHIP .

for higher studies or research work for study in any branch of soience, technology

(1 ) of that section , paruely :

Rules . 1986 ,

(a ) “ Form " means form appended to these rules ; 
(b ) “ Licenom " means a licence granted ander section 6 of the Aot ; and 

(c) “ The Act" means the Prize Competitions .Act, 1986 ( 12 of 1956 ): 
8. Form and manner of applio tion for licence . Every appliontion for a lioenot 
uador sub-section ( 1) of section 6 of the Aot slull be in Form A and shall be either 
gabmitted personally , or sent by registered post, by to applicant to the licensing 
authority 

4. Form and particulars of licence.- ( 1) Every licence shall be in Form B and 
shall be subjeot to the ouaditions and restrictions therein and to the provisions of the 
Act and those rules,

6. Period of validity of licence and its renewal. -Every licence shall be valid 
initially for & period of one year from the date of its issu- and sall lapse on the

DRAFT RULES . 


No. J /35 / 55. - In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 10 of the Behar 
Control of the use and play of Loud - Speakers Act, 1955 (Bohar Act XII of 1955 ), 
as extended to the State of Manipur, by Notification No. F. 11 ( 1 )-J/ 11/56 Govt . 
of India , Ministry of Home Affairs , New Delhi dated the 14th March , 1956 , the 
Chief Commissioner of Manipur is pleasel to make the following rules for carrying 
out the purposes of the said Act in the State of Manipur, the same having been 
previously published as required by the said section : 
1. Definitions :-In these rules , 
( a ) “ The Act” means the Behar Control of the use and play of Loud 

Speakers Act , 1975 as extended to the State of Manipur ; 
(b ) " Form ” means & form appended to these Rules ; 
(c) “ Person " includes & Company, Institution , Club or other Association of 

persons by whatever name called . 
(d ) “ Proscribed authority ” means the District Magistrate whioh includes 

the Additional District Magistrate or any other person that may be 

appointed by the District Magistrate ; 
( e) " Section " means a section of the Act ; 
( 2 ) Restriction against use and play of Loud -speaker --No person shall use and 
play a Loud -epeaker in the following places : 


1 


MANIPUR GAZETTE , MAY 23 , 1956 . 


co 


(a ) within a radius of 4 furlongs from a hospital ; 
(b ) within a radius of 4 furlongs from a building in which there is u tele 

phoue exchange , 
And within the Muuicipal area of a Municipality : 
(c) within a radius of $ furlongs from any alucational institution montioued , 

managed , recngnised or controlled by the Govt. of Manipur or the Con 
tral Govt . or any University ( stablished under any law for the tune being 
in force or a local authority or admitted to 

to such University or any 
hotel inaintained , managed or reco : nised by such institution wlien suca 

institution or hotel is in the use of studunts ; 
(d ) within a radius of 4 furlougy front any building in which a Court is 

held , during the hours of working such Oourt ; (e) between the bours 
10 P. M. and 6 A. M.without the permission in writing of the prescribed 

authority : 
Provided that nothing contained in clauses (a ), (b ) and (c ) of this rule shall 
apply to a person using and playing a loud -- peaker for any cultural, educational 
or humanitarian purposes or purposes connected with the main enance of law 
and order and previous perin18sion in writing of the preseribed authority has 

been obtained in this respect. 
3. Application for permission to use loud -speaker : 

Every application for permission to use and play a loud - speaher shall be made to the 
prescribed anthority and shall : 
(a ) when made under section 3 of the Act , be in Form A and shall bear 

Coui t - fee stamp of one rupee, and

DRAFT RULES . 


No. J / 35 /55. - In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 10 of the Behar 
Control of the use and play of Loud -Speakers Act, 1955 (Behar Act XII of 1955 ) , 
as extended to the State of Manipur, by Notification No. F. 11 (1 )-J / 11/ 56 Govt. 
of India , Ministry of Home Affairs , New Delhi dated the 14th March , 1966 , tho 
Chief Commissioner of Manipur is pleasel to make the following rules for carrying 
out the purposes of the said Act in the State of Manipur, the same having been 
previously published as required by the said section : 
1. Definitions :-In these rules , 
(a) " The Act” means the Behar Control of the use and play of Loud 

Speakers Act , 1955 18 extended to the State of Manipur ; 
(b ) " Form ” means a form appended to these Rules ; 
( c ) 

Person " includes & Company, Institution , Club or other Association of 

persons by whatever name called . 
( d ) “ Proscribed authority ” means the District Magistrate which includes 

the Additional District Magistrate or any other person that may be 

appointed by the District Magistrate ; 
( o ) " Section ” means & Biction of the Act ; 
( 2 ) Restriction against use and play of Loud -speaker -- No person shall use and 
play a Loud - epeaker in the following places : 


MANIPUR GAZETTE , MAY 23, 1956 . 


3 


(x ) within a radius of 4 furlongs from a hospital ; 
(b ) within a radius of 4 furlongs from a building in which there is a tele 

phone exchange , 
And within the Municipal area of a Municipality : 
(c) within a radius of $ furlongs from any olucational institution mantioned , 

managed , teongnised or contrulled by the Govt. of Manipur or the Cen 
tral Govt. or any University established under any law for the time being 
in turce or a local authority or admitted to such University or any 
hotel maintained , maniged or recognised by such institution when suci 

institution or hotel is in the use of students ; 
(d ) within a radius of 4 furlongs from any building in which & Court is 

held , during the hours of working such Court ; (e) between the bours 
10 P. M. and 6 A , M. without the permission in writing of the prescribed 

authority : 
Provided that nothing contained in clauses (a ) , (b ) and (c ) of this rule shall 
apply to a person using and playing a loud - peaker for any cultural, educational 
or humanitarian purposes or purposes connecteil with the maintenance of law 
and order and previous permission in writing of the preseribed authority has 

been obtained in this respect.

Standard and syllabus of the cramination 
1. English Essay . An essay to be written in Engli - h on one of seve 
ral specilied subjects of topical interest , designed to test the candidate s 
capicity for clear and orderly thinking and precise expression . 

2. General Knowledge .-- Including knowledge of current events and of 
such matters of everyday observation and experience in their scientific ax 
pects as may be expected of an educated person who has not made a 
special study of any scientific subject. The piper will also include questions 
on Indian IIistory aud Gjography of a natury wllica candidates shall be 
able to answer without special study. 

Personality test. The candidate will be interviewed by a Board who 
will have before then a record of his career as indicited in bis application . 
He will be asked qurstions with reference to buy own activities and career, 

and on matters of general interest. The object of the interview is to assess 
the personal suitability of the candidate for the Service by a Board of competent 
and unblased observers . The qualities to be judged may be broadly summed 
up as an assebilient of the mental calibre of the candidate , including not 
only intellectual qualities but also social and mural traits of personality. 
Some of the qualities to be julged are mental alertuiess , critical powers of 
assimilation, clear and logical exposition , balance of jurigment, variety and 
depth of interest , ability for social cohesion and leadership , intellectual and 
mral integrity . 

2. The technique of the interview is not that of a strict cross examina 
tion , but of a natural though directed and purposive conversation , which 
is intended to roveal the mental qualities of the candidat . 

3. Candidates are expected to bave tahun an intelligent inte est not only 
in their special subjects of academic study or of their profession , but also 
in the events which are happoning around them both within and without 
their own stato or country , as well as in modern currents of thought, and 
in new discoveries which should rouse the curiosity of well oducated citizens. 

4. The Personality test will ordinarily end up with a Group Discussion 
mong the candidates on a subject of general interest which will be given 
to them ,

NOTE : - Candidates are warned that there is no right of appeal from a 
Medical Board , special or standing ., appoiuted to detormine their fitness for 
the above services. If , however , Government are satisfied on the evidence 
produced before them of the pissibility of an error of judginont in the decision 
of the first Buard , it is open to Government to allow an appeal to a second 
Board . Such evidence should be submitted within one iponth of the date 
of the communication in which the decision of the first Medical Board is 
communicates to the candidate , otherwise no request for an appeal to a 
second Medical Board will be considered . 

If any medical certificato is produced by a candidate as a piece of evidence 
about the possibility of an error of judgment in the decision of the first 
Board , the certificate will not be taken into consideration unless it contains 
#nute by the medical practitioner concerned to the effect that it has been 
given in full knowledge of the fact that the candidate has already been 
rejected as unfit for service by the Medical Board . 

Medical Board s Report 
The following intimation is made for the guidance of the Medical Exa 
miner : 
No person will be deemed qualified for admission to the Public Service 

who shall not satisfy Government or the appointing authority , as the 
Cabe may be , that he has no disease , constitutional affection , or bodily 

infirmity unfitting him , or likely to unfit him for that service. 
It should be understood that the question of fitness involves the future 

as well as the present and that one of the main objects of medical 
examination is to secure continuous effective service , and in the 


17 


case of candidates for permanent appointment to prevent early 
pension or payments in case of premature death . It is at the same 
time to be noted that the question is one of the likelihood of conti 
nuous effectivo service , and that rejection of a candidate need 
not be advised on account of the presence of defect which in 
only a small proportion of cases is found to interfere with continuous 

effective service , 
A lady doctor will be co -opted 99 & member of the Medical Board 

whenever & wcmon candidate is to be examined . 
The report of the Medical Board should be treated as confidential 

and in no case should the caudivute di clared wit be in furmed 

of the cause of rejection . 
In cases where a Medical Board considers that a minor disability dis 

qualifying a candidate for Government servire can be cured by trea 
ment (medical or surgical & statement to that effect should be 
recorded by the Medical Board Thero 19 no objection to a candi 
date being informed of the Board s opinion to this effect by the 
appointing authority and when a cure has been effected it will be 
open to the authority concerned to ask for another Medical Board .

2. No royalty will be loviablo on agricultural impleinents such 28 thrashing 
flails , ploughs, yokes , etc. removed from the Open Reserves by any person for his 
own personal use. 

2. No royalty will be leviable on finished goods suoh as wooden trays, mortars , 
husking - poles , handloom implem int, furniture either made of canos or bamboos or 
wood brought down by any person from the Open Reserves by hond loans for 
personal use or for fabrication and sale by himself. 

3. Persons living in or near the Open Reserves are exempted from payment of 
any royalty on fire-wood , bamboos or canes brought down by them from Open Reserves 
by head loans to the undermentioned recognised market places in the valley for 
sale by themselves .

Notification No. T.M. 38 /37-38,51. 


Dated , Shillong the 16th May , 1956 . 
Subject – Deposit of income- tax demands undur the challans supplied from the 

Income Tax Oflice . 
It is notified for information of all Treasury and Sub - Treasury Officers and Depart 
mental Disbursing Officers and all gazettod Officers in Assam , Tripiird and Manipur 
that the Income-tax demands which are raised in direct assessments on account of 
short deduction at source from their pay bills or on account of other scurces of 
income, in cash , should le deposited under challans supplied from the Income- tax 
Officers. But it is noticed that some Govt. Offiggers are depositing the amount by 
deduction from their pay bills. This procedure Msults in much acrounting difficulty 
so far as such deinands are concerned . The tax on direct assessments relates to 
previous years while tax deducted against current montli s salary is credited against 
the tax due on current year s income. As a result of the defective procedure men 
tioned above the demand in respect of the previous year remains unsatisfied while 
the extra deduction against the current ye ırs salary remains unadjusted till long 
after the end of the financial yeur . 

It is therefore notified that only the monthly deduction of tax should be made 
from pay bills and wheuever tho demand noticis und challans are issued from the 
office of the Income Tax for any amount on direct assessment., the payment should 
be made invariably in cash through the challans supplied by that Departments .

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 3 of the Essen

1. Short title, extent and commencement : 

(i) This order my be called the Cotton Textiles ( Production by Handloom ) 

Control Order, 1966 . 
( ii ) It extends to the whole of India except the State of Jammu and Kashmir . 

( iii ) It sball come into force at once . 
2. Definitions : 
In this Order, unless there is anything repugnent in the subject or context 

(n ) " Form " means a form appended to this Order ;

118ed for the manufacture of Cotton Textiles and which is not worked

1948 (LXIII of 1948 ), and ineludes a semi- automatic handloom ;

in the Cotton Textile ( Control ) Order, 1948 ;

ded any officer authorised in writing in this behalf by the Textile Comini 
ssioner to perform all or any of the functions conferred on the regio 
tering authority by this Order.

NOTIFICATION . 

Imphal, the 8th June, 1956 . 
No. J /37/52. - It has been suggested to the State Government that the marriages 
amongst Christians in this state so far solemuised in local Christian Communities 
require regularisation . The existing practice does not require registration and vot 
got the force of law as it is not carried out under the provisions of an Act now 
in force in this State . It is considered necessary to maintain list of pers ins autho 
rised to solemnize marriage, Marriage Registrar and to prescribed rules where , how 
and when such marriages are to be solemnised . The Indian Christian Marriage Act 
1872 which is in force in other parts of India and which 

all the above 
points has not yet been extended to this State. 

% . It has therefore been proposed that thu Indian Christian Marrige Act should 
be extended to this Stale but before any step to this direction is tahen , the proposal 
is published for general information and any obj ction to this proposal may kindly 
be sent to the address of the undersigacd on or before the 30th June , 1956 .

NOTIFICATION . 

Imphal, the 8th June, 1956 . 
No. J/37/52. - It has been suggested to the State Government that the marriages 
amongst Christians in this state so far Bulemuined in local Christian Communities 
require regularisation . The existing practice does not require registration and not 
got the force of law as it is not carried out under the provisions of an Act now 
in force in this State. It is considered necessary to maintaiu list of persons autho 
rised to solemnize marriage, Marriage Registrar and to prescribed rules where , how 
and when such marriages are to be solemnised . The Indian Christian Marriage Act 
1872 which is in force in other parts of India and which covers all the above 
poiuts has not yet been extended to this State . 

% . It has therefore been proposed that the Indian Christian Marrige Act should 
be extended to this state but before any step to this direction is taken , the proposal 
is published for general information and any obj.ction to this proposal may kindly 
be sent to the address of the undersigacd on or before the 30th June, 1966 .

NOTICE 


Imphal, the 4th June, 1966. 
The Government of Manipur, propose to sponsor some candidates for training 
in Veterinary and Animal Hushandry . 

The course will last for 3/4 years londing to a degree. 

2. It is proposed to recommend to the Goverument of India for suitable can . 
didates for a stipend of Rs. 50 /- per month but no guarantee . can be given that 
the stipends recommended will be granted by them and it they are not granted ; 
the selected candidates must be prepared to meet these expenses themselves. 

3. The stipends, if any , granted will have to be refunded in case the candidate 
fails to complete the training satisfactorily . 

4. Only candidates who have passed the Intermediate Science examination with 
( a ) Chemistry ( b ) Zoology (0 ) Botany or (d ) Biology need apply . 

5. Applications should be submitted to the andes signed in the prescribed form , 
put up on the potice Board of the Office of the Director of Agriculture , (Vety.) 
& Animal Husbandry , Imphal by 20th June 1956 . 

The time, date and place of interview are notified in the notice Boards separate 
carde will not be sent. 

6. Other things being equal, preference will be given to candidate having a 
knowledge of local languages and conditions. 

M. Kanti Raj, 
Director of Agriculture , (Vety ). & 

Animal Husbandry , Imphal.

The Government of Manipur, propose to depute some candidates for training in 
Agriculture . 

The course will last for 3/4 years leading to a degree. 

2. It is proposed to recommend to the Government of India & scholarship of 
Rs . 50 /- a month to each selectod candidate. No. assurance can be given abwut 
the decision of the Government of India and in case the proposal is not acopted 
by them , the candidate will have to undergo the couise entirely at his own expense . 

3. The selected candidates will be considered for employment to Manipur after 
completing the training in any suitable vacancies that may ex18t . 

4. The entire amout paid by Government will have to be refunded in case the 
candidate fails to complete the training satisfaotorily or refused to serve the Gover 
mont on offer of employment. 

5. Only candidates who bave passed the Intermediate Soience examination with 
(a ) Chemistry (b ) Zoology (o) Botany or (d) Biology need apply .

Imphal, the 12th Juno , 1986 . 
No. J /37 /52. - In exercise of the powers omferred by section 30 of the Special Marriage 
Act , 1951 (XLIII of 1954 ) the Chief Commissioner of Manipur is pleased to make the 
following rules : 

RULES . 
1. These rules may be called the Manipur Special Marriage Rules , 1966 . 
2. In these rules , unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context, 

(a ) “ the Act" means the special Marriage Act , 1964 (XLIII of 1984 ) ; 
(b ) " Form meuns a Form appended to these rules ; 
(c ) " Marriage certificate Book " means the Marriage Certificate Book , prescribed 

uador section 13 of the Act ; 
(d ) “ Marriage Notice Book ” means the Marriage Notice Book prescribed under 

section 6 of the Aot ; 
( 6) " Marriage Officer " means the Marriage Ollicer appointed under Sub- section ( 1) 

of Seotion 3 of the Aot ; 
(f) " Registrar -General" means the Registrar General appointed under Act VI of 

1886 ; and 
(9 ) " Section " means a section of the Aot ; 

(b ) " State " means the State of Manipur. 
3. (1) Every marriage officer shall cause his name, designation and the regular 
working hour of his office to be written in English and in the language or languages of 
the State and displayed in a conspicious part of the building in which his office is 
situated . A copy of such notice shall also be published by affixing it to a conspi. 
civus part of the Office of the District Magistrate and Distcict Judge of the State. 

( 2) All registrations at the office shall be made between the hours of 1 ) A. M. 
and 5 P. M. or such bours as the Chief Commissioner may from time to time fix . 

4. ( 1 ) Notice of any intended marriage under the Act shall be given in writing 
in the form specified in the second schedule to the Act , to the Marriage Officer 
by both the parties iotending to enter into the marriage, either in person or by 
registered post. 

( 8) Where the notice is delivered in person , the fee prescribed therefore in rule 
10 shall be paid directly in cash to the Marriage Officer ; .where the potioe is sont 
by registered post, the fee shall be remitted by money order at the remitter s 
expense and the receipt issued to the remitter by the post office through which 
the remittance is made shall be attached to the notice. 
- (3) As soon as the notice has been received by the Marriage Officer, a distino 
tive serial number shall be entered on it and such number and the date of receipt 
of the notice shall be attested by the signature of the Marriage Officer. If the 
notice is in oouforinity with the requironjunts of the Act, it shall be entered in 
the Marriage Notice Bouk in · Forin I which shall be bound volume, and the pagen 
of which sball be machine numbered consecutively with a nominal index attached 
If the notice is not in conformity with the requirements of the Act, it shall be 
got rectified by the parties if they are present, or returned to them by post for 
rectification and re -transmission within a data to be fixed . Every item of reatif 
cation shall be attested by both the parties,

A true copy of the notice under the seal and signature of the Marriage 
Officer shall be exhibited in a caspicious place in his office for thirty days before 
the registration of the marriage. 

6. (1 ) Where an objection bas been made under section 7 to the splemnization 
of an intended marriage and such objection together with the fee prescribed there 
for in rule 10 has been received and recorded by the Marriage Officer , he shall , 
unless by an order in writing he rejects the objection is not based on contraven 
tion of any of the conditions specified in section 4 , enquire into the objection on 
a day to be fixed by him . The day so fixed shall not be latsr than thirty days 
from the date of the receipt of the objection . He shall als ) send a copy of the 
the objection to the parties to the intended marriage. 

(2) The Marriage Officer shall, at the time of recording the objection , ascertain 
from tho objector whether be bus any documents on which he relies or whether 
he desires any witness or witnosses to be exsmined on his behalf. If the objector 
states that he has, the Marring , Officer shall require the objector to produce 
the documents or the witnesses on the day fixed for the enquiry . If the objector 
desires that summonses shall be issued to the witnesses to appear ani give evidence 
or produce any document, the Marriage Officer shall issue such summonses to the 
witnesses cited , on payment of the process fee prescribed therefor in Rule 10 and 
the reasonable exponses of travelling and subsistence of the witnesses. 

(3 ) Marriage Oflicer shall also give notice of the date and tims fixed for the 
enquiry to the parties to the intended marriage. 

(4 ) The notice or summons to any party or witness under this rule shall b3 
in Form II or Form Ill as the case may be and skill be seat by rogistered post . 

(6) On the dato fixed for the enquiry or on any adj surned date , the Murringe 
Oficer shall record in his own hand the evidence given in the course of enquiry . 

(6 ) The enquiry relating to the objection including the production of documents 
and examination of witnesses shall be completed and the decisio a of the Marriage 
Officur arrived at within the period of thirty days specified in section 8. If, within 
the prescribed periud , the documents are not produced and the witnesses do not 
appear before the Marriage Officer, the Marriage Officer shall take decision without 
waiting for the production of such documents or the appearanoe of such witnesses . 

( 7 ) If the Marriage Officer is satisfied that the objection is baseless , he shall 
register , the marriage, otherwise the registration shall be refusod and the reasons for 
such refusal shall be entered in the Register of refusal, which shall be maintained 
by him in Form IV . The order shall be communicated to the parties concorned . 
including the objector . 

(7 ) ( 1) . The place other than a Marriage Officer s 0.6o3 , where a marriage is to 
be registered , shall be determined by the parties themselves , who shall spooily such 
place in writing at the time when the notice of the intended marriage is given to 
the Marriage Officer. Such marriage may be registere i at any reasnable time. 

(2 ) If such place is not a distance of more than five miles from the Marriage 
Officer s Ofice , the travelling allowance for suih attendance shall be two rupees ; 
and if more than five miles, the travelling allowanca shill be six annas por mile , 
in addition to the fee payable under clause (IX ) of rule 10 .

Imphal, the 12th June , 1966

have arranged for the supply of certain tree seedlings to the members of the pabbio

PRESS NOTE . 


Imphal, the 15th June, 1956 . 
Reservation of one seat for Lady in Hardinge Medical College, New Delhi. 
In the Hardinge Medioal College , New Delhi ono soat for Lady has been reserved 
for Manipur State to M. B., B. 8. course für the session commencing from 1st · August 
1966 , 

Intending candidates may submit their applications to the Principal of the College 
in prescribed form according to the instructions contained in the Prospectus copy 
of which may be seen at the Office of the Chief Medical Officer , Manipur. The 
last date of application receipt is the 20th Jund, 1966. 

Candidates must pass the Intermediate Examination of an Indian University 
recognised by the Delhi University with English , Biology, Physics and Chemistry 
( organic and inorganic ). Candidates are required to appear in the adminsion test 
examination at one of the centres namely Madras , Bombay , Caloutta and Delhi 
and competition will however be rastrioted to the candidates of the State for which 
tho seat has been reserved . 

K. G. Singh , 
Asstt . Seoretary , (Medioal) 
to the Government of Manipur .

Tribes and other Backward Clasdes receiving Post - Matriculation education . The scholar 
ships are tenable in recognised institutions in India imparting education beyond

(b ) Commerce. 

(i) Law and Libriry Science .

Subject : - Award of scholarships under the Government of India , Foreign 

Languages scholarships scheme ( 1956-57). 
The Govei pment of India have decided to award one scholarship for Arabio , 
three for Persian and thred fir Turkish languages for studies abroad under their 
Foreign Lanuage Scholarships Scheme, 19 6-57. 


Candidates should have a good University degree and should not be more than 
45 years old . The candidates should have studied the language concerned and 
acquired proficienoy upto the standard for whish facilities for instruction in it are 
available in India except for Turkish for which the candidates should have an elementary 
knowledge or aptitude for that language . 

The scholarships will be normally tonuble for one your and will cover main 
ten no , tuition fees and cost of travel both ways.

ment of India , Ministry of Education , Sobolarships Division (Section 8. I), New 
Delhi. . The last date for receipt. of applications is 16. 7. 1966. Those who have 
already applied for these scholarships under the previous advertisement this year 
for the award for this year need not apply again .

PRESS NOTE NO . 83 . 


Car Festivals of Sri Jaganath of Puri drawing equal near. 

Pilgrims advised to get themselves inoculated . 
The Director of Heath Services, Oringa has issued the following Press Note: 

The Snan , the Car and the Return ( ar Festivals of Sri Jagudnath at Puri como 
off this year on the 23rd Jule , 9th July and the 17th July , 1956 respectively . During 
the festival period , a large number of pilgrims is expected to gather at Puri from 
all over India as in the previous your B. 

in the previous yonis. As sporadic cases of ("holera are 1eported 
from the district itself and from different party of the State , it is apprehended that 
Cholera and other bowel diseases may break out in an epidemic forin during and after 
the Yestival period due to large congregation of pilgrims at Puri and may spread to 
different parts of this State as well as to other States if suitable precautionary measures 
are not adopted sufficiently beforehand . In order to protect the people froin these 
diseases, adequate Sanitary and Public Health arrangements are being mads at Puri 
and different road ride places leading to Puri . Anti- cho ers inoculation has been made 
compulsory in the district of Puri including puri town and arrangement has been made 
to inoculate intending pilgrims at different hus stundr , road - side villages and Hailway 
Stations leading to Puri, free of charge. Hence to make this arrangement a succesu , 
co -operation from public and ihe pilgrims in general is cordially invited in their own 
interest and in the interest of the safety and welfare of the Indiau Union and the 
State . 

The intending pilgrims are therefore strongly advised to (i) get themselves inocu 
lated and to pogreS8 De cessary certificate to that effect which will be issiled by the 
idoculating officer, free of charge , as otherwise they will not be allowed to enter iuto 
the festival areas. Tbe owners of Dharmasalas and Lodging Houses etc. have been 
ipstruoted vot to admit per sons who cannot produco evidence of their having been 
inoculated against Cholera on a date not prior to 16.2.1956 , 

( ii ) Not to take stale or unwholesome and fly.contaminated food stuffs . 
(ii) To use piped water which is specially supplied for drinking purposes , 
(iv ) Not to make the festival area dirty endangering the safety of the public . 
(v) To follow the instructions as may be given by the health staff wirb regard 

to other special stpitary measures at different buling places for pilgrims. 
The intending pilgrims are warned that they will have to run great personal risk or 
undergo inconvenieroe if they attend the festival without being properly protected 
and without obtaining necessary inooulation certificate.

PRESS NOTE N. 88 . 
Car Festival of Sri Jaganath of Pari drawing equal near. 

Pilgrims advised to get themselves inoculated . 
I be Director of Heath Services , Orissa has issued the following Press Note : -- 

The Suun , the car and the Return ,Car Festivals of Sri Jagannath at Puri come 
off the year on the 23rd Juze, 9th July and the 17th July , 1956 rospectively . During 
the festival period , a large number of pilgrims is expected to gather at Puri from 
all over India us in the prerious yeais . As sporadic CABOS of ( bolera are reported 
from the district itself and from different parts of the State, it is apprehended that 
Cholera and other bowel diseases may break out in an epidemic form during and after 
the festival period due to large congregation of pilgrims at Puri and may spread to 
different parts of this state as well as to other States if suitable precautionary measures 
are not adopted suffioiently beforehand. In order to protect the people froin these 
diseases , adequate Sunitary and Public Health arrangements are being made at Puri 
and different rond ride places loading to Puri . Anti-cholera inoculation has been made 
compulsory in the district of Puri inoluding puri town and arrangement has been mide 
to inoculate intending pilgrims at different bus stunds , rond - eide villagos and Railway 
Statious leading to Puri,. free of charge.. Hepco to make this arrangement a success , 
00 -operation from public and the pilgrimsm general is cordially invited in their own 
interest and in the interest of the safety and welfare of the Indian Union and the 
State . 

The intending pilgrims are therefore strongly advised to (i) get themselves inoou 
lated and to poskes8 D + Ceasary certifioute to that effect which will be issued by the 
ino , ulating officer, free of charge , as otherwire they will not be allowed to enter iuto 
the festival areas . The owners of Dharmasalas and Lodging Houses eto . have been 
instructed not to admit persons who cannut produco evidence of their having been 
inoculated against Cholera on a date not prior to 15.2.1956 . 

(ü ) Not to take stale or unwholesome and fly.contaginated fond stuffs . 
(iii) To use piped water which is specially supplied for drinking purposes . 
(iv ) Not to make the festival area dirty endangering the safety of the public. 
(v) To follow the instructions as iney he given by the health staff with regard 

to other special sanitary measures at different balting places for pilgrims. 
The inter ding pilgrims are warned that they will have to ran great personal tisk or 
undergo 11 convenience it tl ey attend the festival without being properly protected 
and without obtaining necessary inoculatiun certificate .

PRESS NOTE No. 88 . 
Car Festivals of Sri Jaganath of Puri drawing equal near. 

Pilgrims advised to get themselves inoculated . 
I be Director of Heath Services, Orinda has issued the following Press Note: 

The Span , the Car and the Return ( ar Festivals of Sri Jagannath at Puri come 
off this year on the 23, d June, 9th July and the 17th July , 1956 respectively . During 
the festival period , a large number of pilgrims is espected to gather at Puri from 
all over India as in the previous years. As sporadic cases of ( bolera are reported 
from the district itself and from different parts of the State , it is apprehended that 
Cholera and other bowel diseases may break out in an epidemic forın during and after 
the festival period due to large congregation of pilgrims at Puri and may sproud to 
different parts of this Stute as well as to other States if suitable precautionary measures 
are not adopted suffiojently beforehand . In order to protect th people froin these 
diseases, adequate Sanitary and Public Health arrangements are being made at Puri 
und different road sido places leading to Puri. Anii -cho era inoculation has been made 
compulsory in the district of Puri including puri town and arrangement has been made 
to inoculate intending pilgrims at different bus stands, road -side villages and Railway 
Stations leading to Puri , free of charge. Hence to make this arrangement a success , 
Co -operation from public and he pilgrims in general is cordially invited in their own 
interest and in the interest of the safety and welfare of the Indian Union and the 
State . 

The intending pilgrims are therefore strongly advised to (i) get themselves inocu . 
lated and to posse =8 Decessary certificate to that effeot which will be issued by the 
ipoculating officer, free of charge , as otherwise they will not be allowed to enter into 
the festival areas. Tbe owners of Dharmasillas and Lodging Houses oto . have been 
instructed not to admit persons who cannut produce evidenee of their having been 
inoculated against Cholera on a date not prior to 15.2.1956 . 

( ii ) Not to take stale or unwholesome and fly.contaminated food stuffs . 
(iii ) To use piped water which is specially supplied for drinking purposes. 
( iv ) Not to make the festival area dirty epdaugering the safety of the public . 
( v) To follow the instructions us way be given by the health staff with regard 

to other special sanitary measures at different balting places for pilgrims. 
1 ba inter ding pilgrims are warned that they will have to run great personal risk or 
undergo is convenience if they attend the festival without being properly protected 
and without obtaining necessary inoculation certificate.
